legend: In a javelin-throwing competition, an athlete faces N$$$N$$$ targets arranged in a field, numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to N$$$N$$$. The athlete wants to hit as many targets as possible, but there's a catch: fatigue accumulates with each successful hit.

The athlete has a limited energy budget of B$$$B$$$ units. Each target i$$$i$$$ has two properties: a base difficulty ai$$$a_i$$$ and a fatigue coefficient bi$$$b_i$$$. If target i$$$i$$$ is the j$$$j$$$-th target hit in sequence, the energy cost to hit it is ai+(j−1)⋅bi$$$a_i + (j-1) \cdot b_i$$$.

Your task is to determine the maximum number of targets the athlete can hit without exceeding this energy budget. Note that the athlete can choose any subset of targets and hit them in any order, as long as the total cost doesn't exceed E$$$E$$$. Every target can be hit at most once.
input: The first line contains two integers N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤104$$$1 \leq N \leq 10^4$$$) and B$$$B$$$ (0≤B≤109$$$0 \leq B \leq 10^9$$$) — the number of targets and the energy budget respectively.
The second line contains N$$$N$$$ space separated integers a1,a2,…,aN$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_N$$$ (0≤ai≤105$$$0 \leq a_i \leq 10^5$$$) — the base difficulties for each target.
The third line contains N$$$N$$$ space separated integers b1,b2,…,bN$$$b_1, b_2, \ldots, b_N$$$ (0≤bi≤105$$$0\leq b_i \leq 10^5$$$) — the fatigue coefficients for each target.
output: Output two integers: the maximum number of targets the athlete can hit without exceeding the energy budget B$$$B$$$ and the energy required to do so.

legend.ai: 在一场标枪投掷比赛中，运动员面对着场地上排列的 N$$$N$$$ 个目标，编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 N$$$N$$$。运动员希望击中尽可能多的目标，但存在一个问题：每次成功击中目标都会累积疲劳。
运动员拥有总量为 B$$$B$$$ 单位的有限能量。每个目标 i$$$i$$$ 有两个属性：基础难度 ai$$$a_i$$$ 和疲劳系数 bi$$$b_i$$$。如果目标 i$$$i$$$ 是按顺序被击中的第 j$$$j$$$ 个目标，那么击中它所需的能量为 ai+(j−1)⋅bi$$$a_i + (j-1) \cdot b_i$$$。
你的任务是确定运动员在不超过能量预算的情况下最多可以击中多少个目标。注意，运动员可以选择任意目标子集，并以任意顺序击中它们，只要总消耗不超过 E$$$E$$$。每个目标至多可以被击中一次。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤104$$$1 \leq N \leq 10^4$$$) 和 B$$$B$$$ (0≤B≤109$$$0 \leq B \leq 10^9$$$)，分别表示目标数量和能量预算。
第二行包含 N$$$N$$$ 个以空格分隔的整数 a1,a2,…,aN$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_N$$$ (0≤ai≤105$$$0 \leq a_i \leq 10^5$$$)，表示每个目标的基础难度。

output.ai: 输出两个整数：运动员在不超过能量预算 B$$$B$$$ 的情况下能够击中的目标数量的最大值，以及完成这一过程所需的能量。
